mainEntity.name: How much does a Peugeot 108 1.2 PureTech engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Peugeot 108 1.2 PureTech (EB2) engine replacement typically costs £1,700-£1,900 for a rebuilt unit with supply and fit through a specialist. Used engines start from around £864-£1,200, while main dealer replacement can exceed £3,000.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of wet belt problems in a Peugeot 108 1.2 PureTech?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common early warning signs include a rattling or ticking noise from the engine, oil pressure warning light illumination, and the presence of belt debris in the oil. If left unaddressed, belt failure can cause oil starvation and catastrophic engine damage.

mainEntity.name: Does the Peugeot 108 1.2 PureTech have a timing belt or chain?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Peugeot 108 1.2 PureTech uses a timing belt - specifically a 'wet belt' that runs submerged in engine oil. Most timing belts do not run in oil, and this design has been the source of significant reliability concerns.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Peugeot 108 1.2 PureTech?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes - if the chassis and body are in good condition, a rebuilt EB2 with upgraded components adds significant value and extends the vehicle's life. Given the vehicle's value (£3,000-£7,000), replacement cost should be evaluated against the car's condition. Check if your vehicle is covered by Stellantis's extended 10-year/175,000km warranty before committing to replacement.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Peugeot 108 1.2 PureTech engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Peugeot 108 1.2 PureTech engine replacement typically takes 2-4 days total. This includes 1-2 days for removal and fitting, plus additional time if the replacement engine requires preparation.

mainEntity.name: What oil should I use in my Peugeot 108 1.2 PureTech?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use 0W-30 or 5W-30 fully synthetic engine oil meeting PSA B71 2290 or B71 2312 specification. The correct oil is critical for the 1.2 PureTech - using the wrong oil can accelerate wet belt degradation. Always use PSA-approved oil and follow the recommended service intervals.

historyTimeline.h2: Peugeot 108 1.2 PureTech - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The Peugeot 108 1.2 PureTech is powered by the PSA EB2-family three-cylinder petrol engine, introduced as a more powerful alternative to the 1.0 VTi. Produced from the 108's 2014 launch through to the end of production in January 2022, the 1.2 PureTech was offered in 82hp form across numerous trim levels.

milestones.description: Peugeot 108 launched with 1.2 VTi / PureTech (EB2 family) producing 82hp (60kW) and 118Nm torque
2022 - EB2-family engines fitted across the 108 range in 82hp (60kW) specification
Timing belt recall campaigns initiated for affected PureTech engines due to wet belt degradation issues
Peugeot 108 production ends in January 2022; no direct successor

commonProblems.h2: Peugeot 108 1.2 PureTech Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Peugeot 108 1.2 PureTech (EB2-family) is a refined three-cylinder petrol engine, but it has a critical design flaw - the "wet belt" timing belt that runs in engine oil. Premature belt degradation can lead to oil starvation and catastrophic engine failure. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing the original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Wet Timing Belt Degradation - Why the Peugeot 108 1.2 PureTech Fails Prematurely
problems.typicalFailureMileage: 40,000-60,000 miles (can occur earlier with poor maintenance)
problems.rootCause: The 1.2 PureTech engine uses a "wet belt" timing belt that runs submerged in engine oil. Over time, the belt material degrades due to chemical reactions with contaminants in the oil, shedding particles into the oil system. These particles can block the oil pickup strainer, leading to oil starvation, low oil pressure, and catastrophic engine failure.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: New timing belt, tensioner, water pump, oil pump belt, sump clean
repairOptions.longevity: Essential preventative maintenance. Specialist belt replacement typically £550-£800

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Remove sump, clean oil pickup strainer, oil and filter change
repairOptions.longevity: Required if belt degradation has occurred but engine damage is not yet present

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of rebuilt EB2 with upgraded components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Recommended if belt has failed and caused oil starvation or catastrophic internal damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Peugeot 108 1.2 PureTech is worth approximately £3,000-£7,000 depending on mileage, condition, and specification. - Vehicle worth under ~£3,500: used engine typically makes more sense than a full rebuilt unit. - Vehicle worth ~£3,500-£5,000: evaluate both; reconditioned is viable if keeping the car 2+ years. - Vehicle worth £5,000+: reconditioned/rebuilt usually justifies the premium via warranty and reliability.
problems.recommendation: Preventative timing belt replacement is the single most important maintenance item for the 1.2 PureTech. Replace the belt at the manufacturer-recommended interval (check with your dealer based on VIN - intervals vary from 60,000 to 112,000 miles depending on production date) or earlier if any signs of degradation are present. Stellantis has issued an extended warranty of 10 years or 175,000 kilometres for affected models - check if your vehicle is covered before paying for repairs. If the belt has failed and caused engine damage, a rebuilt engine with warranty is often the most reliable long-term solution.
